#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    std::stringstream ss(line);
    
    int w, m;
    ss >> w >> m;
    
    bool ok = true;
    std::vector<int> all;
    
    while (m != 0) {
        all.push_back(m % w);
        m /= w;
    }
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < all.size(); ++i) {
        if (all[i] == 0 || all[i] == 1)
            continue;
        if (all[i] == w - 1) {
            size_t j = i + 1;
            while (j < all.size()) {
                if (all[j] == w - 1) {
                    all[j] = 0;
                } else {
                    all[j] = all[j] + 1;
                    break;
                }
                ++j;
            }
            continue;
        }
        ok = false;
        break;
    }
    
    if (ok)
        std::cout << "YES" << std::endl;
    else
        std::cout << "NO" << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
